heldout_answer_span_margin.margin_definition: logp(counterfactual_answer_text first 3 assistant-content tokens) - logp(preferred_answer_text first 3 assistant-content tokens)

selector_design.heldout_policy: Run one locked held-out evaluation bundle on the test manifest.
selector_design.layer_coverage_note: Partial L3 closure only: selection searches all non-zero probe-support features within the existing SAE extraction layers, not a wider SAE sweep.
selector_design.question: Does an intervention-aware SAE selector recover a steerable FaithEval feature set where readout-selected features fail?

target_families.answer_span_selected: Top-k SAE features ranked by validation reduction in counterfactual-minus-preferred answer-text logprob margin over the first 3 assistant-content tokens.
target_families.matched_random: Zero-weight SAE features sampled without replacement from the token-active pool, exact-matched to the utility-selected layer histogram, with within-layer weights proportional to full-sequence token activation rate on the frozen validation split.
target_families.matched_random_answer_span: Zero-weight SAE features sampled without replacement from the token-active pool, exact-matched to the answer-span-selected layer histogram, with within-layer weights proportional to full-sequence token activation rate on the frozen validation split.
target_families.readout_selected: Top positive probe-weight SAE features from the original FaithEval readout.
target_families.utility_selected: Top-k SAE features ranked by validation reduction in misleading-minus-preferred logprob margin.

selector_design.validation_policy: Freeze a single stratified validation/test split; use validation only for feature scoring and selection.
